const render=()=>{const projects=api.getState('projects')||[];const activeId=api.getState('activeProjectId');const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];root.querySelector('[data-metric=projects]').textContent=projects.length;root.querySelector('[data-metric=active]').textContent=activeId?1:0;root.querySelector('[data-metric=open]').textContent=tasks.filter(t=>String(t.status).toLowerCase()!=='done').length;const host=root.querySelector('[data-projects]');host.innerHTML='';projects.slice(0,3).forEach((p,i)=>{const active=String(p.id)===String(activeId);const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='project-card';b.type='button';b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',active?'true':'false');b.innerHTML='
';b.querySelector('.project-name').textContent=p.name||p.title||('Project '+(i+1));b.querySelector('.badge').textContent=active?'ACTIVE':'READY';b.addEventListener('click',()=>{api.setState('activeProjectId',p.id);api.log(1,'Active project changed to '+(p.name||p.title||p.id));});host.appendChild(b);});};render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);
